title: Metric report data file
description: One file describes ONE release (one model per test set). scripts/build_report.py fills a copy of report_layout.html from one or more of these; passing several (oldest first) plots them as comparison bars, the last being the current release. The current release also defines the test set the page describes: taxonomy, dataset, metric_spec, label and version are taken from the LAST file that provides them, so the class axis and the parameter table always belong to the release under review and older releases show a dash where they carry no key. Metric keys are exactly what the eval suites emit: '[filter/]name_range' (e.g. 'region_road/mAP_car_0m_50m'). NaN is encoded as null.

schema_version.description: Contract version; the builder rejects a version it does not understand.

repo_url.description: Base URL for commit links (optional). Taken from the first file that sets it.

release.description: Release notes shown at the top of the report (optional): the release name, one headline sentence, and the major changes in the model and in the test as short bullet points. Taken from the LAST file that provides it, so the page always describes the current release.

name.description: Release name as shown in the heading, e.g. v0.1.0.

headline.description: One sentence: what this release is and whether its numbers compare with the previous one.

model.description: Major changes in the model, training and export.

test.description: Major changes in the test set, ground truth definition and metrics.

test_sets.description: One entry per test set the release was evaluated on. Files are aligned across releases by test_set.id.

id.description: Stable id; the same id across files is one test set with one bar group per release.

version.description: Test-set version; releases with a different MAJOR are greyed as a different test set.

tasks.description: Which metric sections show for this test set.

notes.description: Free text shown in the report's test-set section, e.g. what changed against the previous evaluation.

taxonomy.description: Label vocabulary the release was scored on, one entry per task in tasks. The page draws its per-class rows from the classes and its behaviour-group rows from the group names, so the class axis is data, never a constant of the layout.

classes.description: Trained class names in suite order.

groups.description: Behaviour group name (grouped_ prefix) to its member classes; a full partition of classes.

models.description: Usually one model (this release). The builder concatenates these across files in file order.

model.description: Model family; drives the base chart colour (releases of one family share it).

test_set_version.description: If its MAJOR differs from the test set's version, this release is greyed + flagged.

metric_spec_bundle.description: Bundle version of the metric spec this release was computed with.

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint the test run evaluated, shown when no artifacts_url is given.

train_run.description: Tracking id of the training run the checkpoint came from.

run_id.description: Tracking id of the test run the metrics were read from.

metrics.description: bucket -> flat metric dict. Buckets: det3d, det3d_grouped, det3d_visible, det3d_overall, seg3d, seg3d_grouped, segdet3d (partial detection, joint test sets only).
